display.purpose: Page titles and reader article headings — the one editorial moment.

title.purpose: Panel headings, card titles, structural labels.

body.purpose: Interface text, descriptions, agent replies. Reader prose caps at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, table heads, IDs, status posture. The only uppercase role.

shadows.name: edge-line
shadows.purpose: The only elevation in light mode — crisps a card/panel bottom edge as a hairline, never a float.

shadows.name: edge-line-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode equivalent of the edge line.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft box-shadow ring for text fields (--focus-ring). Derived from --accent so it tracks the theme; non-field controls use the crisp --focus-outline (2px solid accent) instead.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default state transition (color/border/background) on buttons, controls, links.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Suggested ease-out curve for any new entrance/reveal — replaces the system's current linear ease where motion is meaningful.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled-accent action. Used once per context for the primary commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #094540; border-radius: 6px; background: #0d5e57; color: #fff; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #094540; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #0d5e57 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action — the default non-primary control.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #cdc9bd; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #1a1d1c; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9fb0aa; background: #faf9f5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #0d5e57 22%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled field. Mono uppercase label above a hairline-bordered control.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field > span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6c6f6a; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #cdc9bd; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #1a1d1c; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0d5e57; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #0d5e57 24%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Carries state only — never decoration. One variant per signal.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-ok { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2f7a4d 16%, transparent); color: #2f7a4d; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #2f7a4d 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mutually exclusive view choice. Active tab gets a white surface and petrol-ink text.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #e2dfd6; border-radius: 8px; background: #faf9f5; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #6c6f6a; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-seg button:hover, .ds-seg button.is-active { border-color: #c5dad5; background: #fff; color: #094540; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Framed work area. Hairline border + edge-line, never a floated shadow.
components.html:
Layer counts

Knowledge, source, and wisdom pages tracked by the active base.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #e2dfd6; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(20,29,28,0.04); padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1d1c; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; color: #6c6f6a; }

narrative.overview: dikw-web is a precision instrument for reading and reasoning over a personal knowledge base. Like a well-made reference tool, it earns trust by receding: the chrome is calm warm-stone and hairline structure, and the knowledge is the only thing allowed to carry color and weight. A single deep-petrol accent is the instrument's one indicator light; it appears rarely and means something every time. Density is a feature — built for sustained expert use — but earned through rhythm, alignment, and restraint, never clutter. Depth comes from a 1px tonal line, not drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-stone neutral canvas; never true white as the page background.
One accent (deep petrol) used on ≤10% of any screen.
Hairline borders and tonal layering instead of shadows.
Serif for titles/reading, sans for UI, mono for IDs/paths/labels.
Full light + dark parity; the reader keeps a low-glare dark surface.

rules.name: The One Indicator Rule
rules.body: Deep petrol is the only chromatic accent and appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the signal. Never introduce a second brand accent.

rules.name: The No-True-White-Background Rule
rules.body: The page background is always warm stone (#f5f3ee), never #ffffff. White is a raised-surface color.

rules.name: The Mono-Only-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + letter-spacing is permitted exclusively in the JetBrains Mono label role. Never set sans or serif in tracked uppercase — that is the AI eyebrow tell.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from 1px borders and surface tone, never blur. If you reach for box-shadow with a blur radius > 1px, use a border instead.

dos: Do keep the page background warm stone (#f5f3ee); reserve #ffffff for raised surfaces.
Do spend the deep-petrol accent rarely (≤10% of a screen) and only where it means something.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairline borders and surface tone; depth is structural, not floated.
Do keep radii on the 4 / 6 / 8 / 999 scale; controls at 6px, cards at 8px, pills fully round.
Do confine uppercase + letter-spacing to the JetBrains Mono label role.
Do maintain WCAG AA in both light and dark, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS dashboards — no multi-color status walls, hero-metric blocks, or heavy drop-shadow card grids.
Don't reach for the AI-template look — no cream/terracotta, no tracked uppercase eyebrows, no 01/02/03 decoration.
Don't add heavy decoration or motion — no glassmorphism, glow/bloom, gradient text, or large entrance animations.
Don't crowd or over-color — no neon, no second accent, no oversized radii (stray 10/12/14px is drift), no icon-everywhere decoration.
Don't use border-left/border-right > 1px as a colored accent stripe; use a full border, a tint, or a leading marker.
Don't introduce a 24px soft drop shadow — it's invisible on warm stone and reads as a 2014 app; use a hairline.
